# MileDeck — 2026 IRS Auto Mileage & Tax Deduction Tracker ($14.99 Once)

> MileDeck is a privacy-first, 100% on-device automatic mileage log and tax deduction tracker for iOS. Built as a one-time buyout alternative to $90-$140/yr subscription trackers like MileIQ and Everlance, MileDeck features built-in 2026 IRS split-period rates ($0.725/mi Jan-Jun, $0.76/mi Jul-Dec), tactile swipe classification, and audit-ready Schedule C PDF & CSV logbooks with zero cloud GPS tracking.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Does MileDeck upload my home address or daily GPS routes to cloud servers?** Never. MileDeck runs 100% on-device with zero account creation and zero cloud GPS telemetry. Your trips stay strictly on your iPhone until you export your PDF/CSV tax report.
- **How does MileDeck handle the 2026 IRS mileage rate split?** MileDeck automatically applies the exact rate based on each drive's date ($0.725/mi H1 and $0.76/mi H2, plus Medical, Charity, or custom mi/km reimbursement rates).
- **Is there a free tier before buying Lifetime Pro?** Yes — classify up to 20 drives every month completely free, then unlock unlimited drives and CPA exports forever with a single one-time purchase.
